name: mamba_combat_pair
description: Two male black mambas in ritual combat: lower bodies wound round each other in a rope-like 2.5-turn twist rising from the ground, tails trailing out left and right along the ground, fronts raised side by side and leaning on each other, heads at about local y -385 (left one faces left, right one faces right), mouths closed, rigid. Olive-grey library palette; the second male is a touch darker so the twist reads. Anchor bottom-centre; bbox about x -255..+255, y -410..0.
